earnings.title: FOR RELEASE – Oct. 27, 2026
highlights: Corning grew third-quarter core sales 19% year over year to $5.08 billion – the strongest growth since the launch of Springboard – and grew core EPS nearly twice as fast to $0.91.
(1) Third-quarter GAAP results: GAAP sales were $4.86 billion, GAAP gross margin was 37.3%, GAAP operating margin was 18.8%, GAAP EPS was $0.78 , and operating cash flow was $1.06 billion.
Optical Communications continued to drive powerful growth, with Q3 sales up 44% to $2.38 billion; Enterprise Networks grew sales 84%, with Gen AI product sales growing more than 100% year over year.
Solar grew sales 37% year over year, as production continued to ramp, albeit at a slower pace than anticipated.
Overall, the company is making solid progress building a more than $3 billion Solar revenue stream.

quotes.text: We delivered an outstanding third quarter. Year over year, core sales grew 19% to $5.08 billion, and core EPS grew 36% to $0.91.

When we upgraded Springboard in May, we laid out a path to double our annualized sales run rate from $20 billion to $40 billion by the end of 2030. We also expect to grow earnings faster than sales, with significantly higher ROIC and substantially more free cash flow.

outlook: In the fourth quarter, management expects to grow core sales approximately 19% year over year to a range of $5.2 billion to $5.3 billion and grow core EPS approximately 36% year over year to a range of $0.96 to $1.00.
